title: Konkona Sen Sharma Shares Dengue Recovery Update From Hospital Bed
excerpt: The actor posted a hospital-bed photo on Instagram, told followers she is 'better now,' and was back at Lust Stories 3 promotions by Sunday.
body:
• Konkona Sen Sharma posted a photo from her hospital bed on Instagram, revealing she was hospitalised with dengue.
  • The actor told followers she is recovering: "Guys, watch out for dengue. Was in the hospital but better now."
  • By Sunday she had resumed professional commitments, sharing photos from promotions for Netflix's Lust Stories 3.
  • She spent her recovery time reading, and used the post to urge fans to be vigilant about the illness.

Actor Konkona Sen Sharma has shared a health update with fans after being hospitalised with dengue, posting a photograph from her hospital bed on Instagram and confirming she is on the mend.

"Guys, watch out for dengue. Was in the hospital but better now," she wrote in her Instagram Stories alongside the picture, in which she is seen sitting up in bed and saluting the camera. By Sunday, she had already resumed professional commitments, sharing photographs from promotional activity for her latest release, the Netflix anthology Lust Stories 3.

The update

Reports suggest the actor spent much of her recovery time reading. The tone of the post was characteristically matter-of-fact: a brief confirmation that she had been admitted, an assurance that she is feeling better, and a word of caution for followers about the mosquito-borne illness.

"Guys, watch out for dengue. Was in the hospital but better now."

— Konkona Sen Sharma, on Instagram

The update comes just days after the actor was in the news for a much lighter reason — a playful birthday post for actor Amol Parashar that set off a fresh round of speculation about the two, who co-starred in the 2019 film Dolly Kitty Aur Woh Chamakte Sitare. Their friendship has continued since, though both have kept questions about the nature of their relationship private.

Back to work

Konkona is currently seen in Lust Stories 3, which premiered on Netflix on September 18. The anthology features an ensemble including Radhika Apte, Vijay Varma and Abhishek Banerjee, with segments directed by Vikramaditya Motwane, Kiran Rao, Shakun Batra and Vishal Bhardwaj. She was also recently seen in Search: The Naina Murder Case.

A National Award-winning actor known as one of Hindi cinema's most discerning performers, she has balanced mainstream and independent cinema throughout her career — and her social media presence tends to be as direct and unvarnished as her choice of roles. Her recent run of streaming projects has kept her firmly in the public eye, and Lust Stories 3 ranks among the most high-profile anthologies of the season.

Dengue in context

Dengue remains a recurring public health concern in India, with research projecting rising risk in the years ahead — including studies that have linked El Niño patterns to higher transmission and warned of significant increases by 2040. For diaspora readers travelling to India during the monsoon months, it is a familiar seasonal hazard.

What's next

With the hospital chapter behind her and promotions back underway, Konkona appears to have turned the corner. Fans will likely see her continue the promotional run for Lust Stories 3 as she completes her recovery.
